lead_deck: Lycian Waterway Walk and Patara Nomad Migration event took place
lead_body: The 23rd Lycian Waterway Walk and Patara Nomad Migration event took place in Kaş. The event showcased the rich history and culture of Lycia. It managed to attract many tourists from Kalkan and Kaş.
